implementation.detail: Implementation commit 34ba392e16df1273dcd54f68a25563f2c0597f7c adds exactly the six allowed files (adapter, tests, two docs, packet JSON and dependency lock) with no changes to existing BPE/shard/corpus, harness, CI, configs or registry. Adapter: HF ByteLevel BPE, no normalization, add_prefix_space=False, explicit regex, all 256 byte symbols, fixed PAD0/BOS1/EOS2/UNK3/reserved4-7, min_frequency=2, max_token_length=128, deterministic sorted train-only input, TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false, 16k/32k targets with actual size reported. Literal special strings fail closed; control/UNK/OOV emissions are rejected; exact UTF-8 round-trip enforced; boundaries are explicit; encode capped at 4096 bytes and decode at 4098 tokens. Artifact is canonical, bounded to 8 MiB, hash/reload checked and independently pinned for the qualified demo. Default probe does not import tokenizers.

source_review.detail: Metadata-only packet covers eight prose families (4 EN/4 PL): two train, one validation and one test family per language, with no family split across splits. Standard Ebooks item pages and first item-history revisions were rechecked; Wolne Lektury API records and official author life dates were rechecked. Pan Tadeusz is officially Epos, recorded as verse_epic and excluded from the prose pilot. Caps are 10 MiB total and 2.5 MiB per item with no work truncation. All candidates remain pending; EU/Polish/Spain rights, four Standard Ebooks author dates, checksums/immutable revisions, annotations/illustrations and benchmark checks block acquisition and training. No text, snapshot, gated access or rights clearance occurred.
